description.subject: Young East Asian woman, around early 20s, fair skin, long straight dark navy-blue hair with blunt wispy bangs, a small silver star-shaped hair clip on the right side, natural soft makeup with pinkish lips, calm serious expression looking directly at the camera
description.pose: Crouching / squatting low on the asphalt, knees bent and pointing toward camera, right elbow resting on her knee with her right hand cupping her cheek and chin, left arm hanging down with relaxed fingers near the ground, upper body leaning slightly forward

clothing.top: Oversized plain white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt with a small dark logo partially visible at the chest
clothing.bottom: Loose wide-leg light-wash blue denim jeans
clothing.footwear: Chunky white and metallic silver dad-style sneakers with white crew socks
clothing.accessories: Small silver star hair clip, thin silver ring on the left hand

description.setting: Urban outdoor scene on an empty asphalt road or overpass under a bright blue sky with a few wispy white clouds; tall modern glass skyscrapers rise behind her, one very tall tapering blue-glass tower on the right and two high-rises on the left; grey metal guardrails and a pale concrete railing run behind her, with green trees at mid-right
description.lighting: Bright natural daylight, sunny clear weather, soft even light on the subject with gentle shadows, vivid sky
description.composition: Vertical full-body shot taken from a very low angle near ground level, wide-angle perspective that enlarges the sneakers in the foreground and makes the skyscrapers tower over her; subject centered, buildings converging toward the top of the frame
description.style: Photorealistic street-fashion / K-style casual editorial portrait, clean sharp details, slight wide-angle distortion
description.colors: Sky blue, navy blue hair, white, light denim blue, silver, asphalt grey, touches of green
description.mood: Cool, confident, laid-back urban streetwear vibe
